errors.general: Something went wrong inside Chausar. Try again; if it happens again, send a report from the business menu.
errors.UNLOCK_FAILED: That passphrase or code didn't open it. Check Caps Lock and try again.
errors.VAULT_CLOSED: This business is closed. Open it again from the list.
errors.VAULT_LOCKED: This business is closed. Open it first.
errors.VAULT_EXISTS: A business is already kept in that place. Pick an empty one.
errors.NOT_BUILT_YET: There is no business here yet.
errors.OFFLINE: Chausar isn't answering right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: This browser isn't connected to Chausar. Open the link from your Chausar app again.
errors.CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE: The saved sign-in for this server couldn't be read. Save it again before you use it.
errors.UI_NOT_BUILT: Phone access isn't ready in this copy of Chausar. Reinstall Chausar, then try again.
errors.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Type the business name to delete it.
errors.REENTRANT_TRANSACTION: Chausar was still saving something. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CUSTODY_SNAPSHOT_REQUIRED: Chausar was still saving something. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This copy of Chausar can't do that here.
